source.stem:
One method of preventing the rusting of iron is to keep oxygen away from the surface of the metal.

Which way of rust prevention does not use this method?

options.text: connecting the iron to a more reactive metal

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: The fatty lumps obtained by churning curd are buttermilk.

intelligence.enrichment: Churning is used to obtain butter from curd and is the method associated with separating cream from milk. Agitating the milk product causes the butter or cream component to separate from the remaining liquid portion. The learner correctly applies this rule: Churning is used to obtain butter from curd and is the method associated with separating cream from milk. Churning means any mixing of a liquid, so it can separate any liquid mixture.
